items.statement: Let E be a finite-dimensional complete real Hilbert space with its Borel structure, including rank zero, and S a measurable parameter space. Let V be globally C2 with kappa>=1 and kappa^-1 norm(v)^2<=D²V(x)[v,v]<=norm(v)^2 for every x,v. For measurable eta/y with every eta(s)>0, there exists a measurable unique stationary proximal point p. Define the actual normalized volume tilt mu, its actual quadratic RGO reweighting R, its actual affine standardization r about that same p, the displayed smooth residual rho, and gamma=stdGaussian E. For every s, r(s) is a probability, absolutely continuous with respect to gamma, canonical KL is finite, gradient rho(s) is L2(r(s)), and canonical KL(r(s)||gamma).toReal<=eta(s)^2*real(finrank E)/2. No step-size upper bound, caller witness, law, coherence, domain or desired-bound certificate is assumed.
assumptions: Finite complete real Hilbert/Borel E and measurable S. Finite rank zero and measurable families are explicit authored extensions; Unit recovers fixed source parameters.
V is globally C2 and kappa>=1, with the exact normalized evaluated Hessian bounds kappa^-1 norm(v)^2<=D²V(x)[v,v]<=norm(v)^2 for all x,v.
eta/y are measurable and eta(s)>0 at every s, without an upper restriction.

Actual unique measurable p, probability/AC/finite canonical KL and true smooth-rho gradient L2 are internally produced outputs. Finite KL is retained before toReal; canonical logRN is not pointwise differentiated.
